name: Data Engineer
description: SQL depth, data modelling, Python and the system design basics data teams ask about.
roadmap:
**Weeks 1-3: SQL.** Joins, window functions, query plans; 5 queries a day.
**Weeks 4-5: Modelling.** Normalisation vs star schemas; slowly changing dimensions.
**Weeks 6-7: Python.** Data structures, generators, writing clean ETL code.
**Weeks 8-9: Design.** Batch vs streaming pipelines, partitioning, idempotent loads.
**Then:** an SDE mock and a system design mock.
